name: zmax-gui
description: zmax-gui — desktop GUI wrapper around the zmax editor (Helix fork). Runs the zmax binary in an embedded PTY terminal with the shared zgui-core baseline.

scripts.dev: pnpm install && node scripts/copy-embed-terminal.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:dev: pnpm install && node scripts/copy-embed-terminal.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.build: pnpm install && node scripts/copy-embed-terminal.mjs && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build: pnpm install && node scripts/copy-embed-terminal.mjs && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:ci: pnpm install && node scripts/copy-embed-terminal.mjs && tauri build --ci --no-sign
scripts.doc:sync: pnpm run doc && command rm -rf docs/api && mkdir -p docs && cp -R app/src-tauri/target/doc docs/api
